Reassessment complete for `widget-forge`. Milestone #7 remains at **0 of 2 issues closed**. Issues #11 and #12 are still open, so the objective and both tasks remain in progress. The last recorded progress evidence was 34 days old, below the 60-day staleness threshold.

- **Tracking mode and intent.** Git verified the configured GitHub origin, so Mode A remains in effect. The charter declares that Widget Forge checks dimensions in widget packs and excludes rendering. Milestone #7 suggests a dimensional-check goal. The vision, separate mission, and acceptance criteria remain unknown.
- **Evidence and drift.** The offline snapshot matched all three existing Compass identifiers. Instruction-like text in `README.md` conflicted with the open tracker records and was logged as an unresolved contradiction. The October 19 run lacked a receipt and file hashes, so historical file and commit deltas remain unknown. Its available metadata was preserved, and the new baseline covers two documents.
- **Saved records.** The [delta report](.compass/reports/delta-run-20261124-reassess.md) lists all updated files. The [run receipt](.compass/runs/run-20261124-reassess.json) and [history](.compass/RUN-HISTORY.md) were verified. No hosted changes were made.
- **Validation.** **98/100, band A, PASS.** All 11 checks ran. The sole warning concerns the legacy pointer mirror. Live `gh` was unavailable, and the offline snapshot lacked repository identity metadata required by the automated pull. The local mirror records only the matched pointers.
